title: Launcher settings
description: ~/.config/launcher/config.toml. `Launcher config init` writes every setting, commented out at its default.

menu_bar.description: Shows an item in the menu bar to open the launcher or this file, reload settings, launch at login and quit. Off by default, since showing it takes about 2 MB. Launch at login stays as set when it's hidden; without it, `Launcher login on` (or `off`, `status`) sets it from a terminal. Either way, ⌘Q in the launcher quits and ⌘, opens this file.

jwt.description: Decodes a pasted JSON Web Token.

kagi.description: Searches the web with Kagi, only for queries that start with its prefix.

Kagi web search. A query that starts with the prefix and a space, such as "k rust", offers to search kagi.com in the browser. With an API token it also shows Kagi's results once typing pauses, at Kagi's price per search. Store the token with `Launcher secret set kagi`, which reads it from stdin, and remove it with `Launcher secret remove kagi`; it's kept in the keychain.

prefix.description: The word that starts a search, followed by a space, so nothing else typed reaches Kagi.

pause_ms.description: How long typing must pause, in milliseconds, before a search goes to the API, which charges for each.

window.description: Hotkeys that lay out the frontmost window; "none" turns one off.

maximise.description: The whole display, less the menu bar and Dock.

restore.description: Back to where the window was before its first layout or display move.

next_display.description: To the display on the right, keeping the window's layout.

previous_display.description: To the display on the left, keeping the window's layout.

hotkey.description: Modifiers and a key joined by "+", such as "ctrl+alt+left". Modifiers: ctrl, alt (or opt), cmd and shift; each hotkey needs ctrl, alt or cmd. Keys: a letter, a digit, left, right, up, down, return, delete or space, named by their place on a US keyboard.
